# jQuery Simple Timer (vendored)

- Version: 0.0.5
- Source: https://github.com/caike/jQuery-Simple-Timer
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Usage: cooking timers (`cooked-timer` handle, front end).
- Local changes: a modified fork. Adds an `update` event (marked `/* BOXY */`) and
  keeps an older internal structure. Do not replace it with upstream without
  porting that event.

Bump the version in `src/Frontend/Enqueues.php` (`cooked-timer` handle) when the
files change.
